note: The two sets are essentially identical in content: the same 22 claims, differing only in wording ('science instrument count' vs 'instrument count', 'Lynx' vs 'Lynx mirror assembly' for the 10 m focal length). Both capture the correct baseline specs (HabEx 4 m/4 instruments/52 m starshade, LUVOIR-A 15 m/4, LUVOIR-B 8 m/3, Lynx 3 m/10 m focal length/3, Origins 5.9 m/3) and both make the same errors. Neither is better on correctness, coverage, or faithfulness.
remarks: Both sets share identical defects: fragment entities 'n-axis telescope' and 'axis telescope' (text-layer artifacts of 'on-axis'/'off-axis') with instrument counts misbound away from LUVOIR-A/LUVOIR-B; 'grazing incidence mirror assembly' given the 3 science instruments (belongs to Lynx as a mission) and given 10 m as 'dimension'/'diameter' when 10 m is the focal length; vague 'spacecraft | science instrument count | 4' (actually the HabEx telescope spacecraft); duplicate starshade-diameter and Lynx 3 m claims. Several quotes are truncated or garbled ('grazing incidence mir', 'a 10 m nd three science instruments', 'Lynx: ... and three science instruments'). All substantive facts on the page are covered by both sets.
